overview.text: Today's landscape features major industry milestones and technical advances across models, architectures, and market structures. Anthropic has priced its initial public offering of Class A common stock, marking a significant market event. In model releases and announcements, Google DeepMind introduced Gemini 4 Neon alongside the availability of Genie 4. Research contributions address critical efficiency and capability challenges. CurvDelta introduces low-curvature delta modeling for surgical learning and unlearning to preserve general capabilities during adaptation. QDA targets closed-loop LLM quantization design with agents to optimize deployment costs, while Decoding Without a Decoder eliminates traditional decoder complexity by predicting pixels directly from diffusion transformers using a linear head. Additionally, Piccolo presents a family of multimodal decision models spanning sizes from 0.8B to 27B parameter counts that co-evolve capabilities and data through recursive self-improvement.

entries.title: Anthropic prices initial public offering
entries.summary: Today Anthropic, PBC priced its initial public offering of its Class A common stock.
entries.why: Marks a major financial milestone as Anthropic prices its initial public offering of common stock.

entries.title: CurvDelta: Low-Curvature Delta Modeling For Surgical Learning and Unlearning
entries.summary: A central challenge in adapting large language models (LLMs) is capability preservation: an adaptation can achieve its target while degrading general capabilities.
entries.why: Preserves general model capabilities during adaptation by addressing surgical learning and unlearning via low-curvature delta modeling.

entries.title: QDA: Closed-Loop LLM Quantization Design with Agents
entries.summary: Post-training quantization is the standard way to serve large language models at low cost. However, the best quantization recipe differs across models and precisions.
entries.why: Optimizes serving costs through closed-loop agentic design for post-training quantization recipes across models and precisions.

entries.title: PReMind: When Personal Memory Meets Visual Hazards
entries.summary: Personalized vision-language assistants use visual observations and personal memories to provide advice tailored to the user.
entries.why: Integrates personal memories and visual observations to provide tailored advice in personalized vision-language assistants.

entries.title: Decoding Without a Decoder: Direct Pixel Prediction from Diffusion Transformers
entries.summary: Latent diffusion models rely on a decoder to map denoised latents to pixels, adding complexity and inference cost. We introduce Decoding Without a Decoder (DWD), which lets a finetuned diffusion transformer produce final pixels directly through a linear head.
entries.why: Reduces inference cost and complexity by enabling diffusion transformers to predict final pixels directly through a linear head.

entries.title: Piccolo: Co-Evolving Decision Models and Data through Recursive Self-Improvement
entries.summary: We present Piccolo, a family of multimodal decision models (0.8B to 27B) that coevolves model capabilities and training data via Agentic Data Engineering and recursive self-improvement (RSI).
entries.why: Co-evolves multimodal decision models and training data through recursive self-improvement and agentic data engineering.
